stages.name: Plan
stages.does: Turns the ask into searches, hashtags and a keep/drop rule.

output.NAME: sun-belt-nostalgia-scroll
output.TITLE: Sun Belt Boomer Nostalgia Scroll
output.WHOSE_SCROLL: A woman in her late 50s-60s in the Sun Belt who grew up tanning in the 70s and 80s and now scrolls for throwback nostalgia, marriage/family humor, and feel-good reveals.
output.KEEP_RULE: A post belongs if it's nostalgia, family/marriage humor, cute-animal or satisfying-reveal content she'd forward to a friend for a laugh — nothing about skin, sun, or a product.
output.DROP_RULE: Drop anything that leaked in from the sun/nostalgia angle but is actually a tutorial, review, or sales pitch — sunscreen ads, anti-aging skincare routines, dermatologist tips, 'sun damage repair' product content.

stages.name: Pull
stages.does: Runs every search on TikTok, Instagram and YouTube; turns away ads, old posts and small posts at the door.

stages.name: Sift
stages.does: Sorts every new post into a lane: entertainment, educational, selling or junk. Only the first two stay.
